MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p,
     2026 - CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) - CASE WHEN CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age,
     r,
     t
WHERE age <= 78
   OR (r.tenure = 'latest' AND t.team_name = 'Capitanes de Arecibo')
   OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0
   OR CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1
RETURN DISTINCT p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player

OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p, r, t,
     CASE
       WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL OR p.birth_date = '' THEN NULL
       ELSE 2026 - CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64)
         - CASE
             WHEN CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '/([0-9]+)/', 1) AS INT64) > 10
               OR (CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '/([0-9]+)/', 1) AS INT64) = 10
                   AND CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '/[0-9]+/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS INT64) > 14)
             THEN 1 ELSE 0
           END
     END AS age
WHERE age <= 78
   OR (r.tenure = 'latest' AND t.team_name = 'Capitanes de Arecibo')
   OR (p.mvp_awards IS NOT NULL AND p.mvp_awards <> '' AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0)
   OR (p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL AND p.olympic_gold_medals <> '' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 1)
RETURN DISTINCT p.draft_year AS col1, age AS col2, p.nationality AS col3, p.name AS name_player
